reason: Fixed only in 11.0.1+, and the latest electron-builder (26.18.0, via app-builder-lib) still requires ^10.2.5, so no compatible patched release exists; `npm audit fix --force` would downgrade electron-builder to 25.1.0. Only paths are the devDependency electron-builder -> app-builder-lib and -> @electron/universal, which glob the project's own `files` patterns on the build machine; the DoS needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern.
